DEFECT-B01 (mine, same class lane A hit twice): the first reset attempt ran node on a $HOME-expanded /c/... scratchpad path while MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 was set; Git Bash left the path unconverted and node resolved it under D: and exited 1. The migrate in the SAME compound command then ran anyway (no && between them) against a NOT-reset database and printed exit 0. A gate that ran on the wrong state is not a gate: the reset+migrate was redone from inside the worktree with a relative script path, and only that second run counts. Rule adopted: never chain a gate after a step whose exit code is not checked.
